title: Further Definition of “Swap”-Inclusions
summary: Commodity Futures Trading Commission — Proposed Rule — Consistent with its jurisdiction over swaps, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("Commission" or "CFTC") is proposing to further define the term "swap" to explicitly include event contracts, including those based on sports-, politics-, cultural-, and weather- related events (the "Proposal").

title: Further Definition of “Swap” To Exclude Casino-Style Gambling Products
summary: Commodity Futures Trading Commission — Rule — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("Commission" or "CFTC") is adopting an interim final rule ("Interim Final Rule") to codify its longstanding position that casino-style gambling products, including wagers placed on sportsbooks and casino games, are excluded from the "swap" definition.
